description: Every OpenRouter event stream ends with the sentinel frame `data: [DONE]` (the spec marks each text/event-stream response with `x-speakeasy-sse-sentinel: [DONE]`, which the converter does not read). Without `done` the sentinel is decoded as one more event. Source: https://openrouter.ai/openapi.json (fetched 2026-10-05), https://openrouter.ai/docs/api-reference/streaming.
